build.buildCommand: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction --prefer-dist --no-scripts && php artisan package:discover --ansi && npm ci && npm run build

deploy.preDeployCommand: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force && php artisan config:clear && php artisan route:clear && php artisan view:clear && php artisan config:cache && php artisan route:cache && php artisan view:cache
